deployer_risk_rules.note: adapted for free-only board: mulight's fresh-deployer rule was paid-only, so rule11d is a caution flag, not a gate

rules.rule: same deployer launches 3+ differently-named projects within 24h -> exclude
deployer with a rugged project in history (no pool or no payback within 48h, then collapsed) -> blacklist, exclude all their projects
same contract bytecode deployed 3+ times within 24h -> exclude
deployer wallet created within ~8h -> caution flag only for free projects; do not auto-exclude
claimed progress counts only if >=20 distinct wallets minted; fewer -> progress untrusted, do not trust the progress number

deployer_risk_rules.unknown_handling: deployer address unverifiable -> mark 'deployer unverified'; rules 11a/11b/11c cannot fire, 11d flags caution, 11e uses on-chain mint events when readable, otherwise progress is 'unverified'
